# Northlight Advisory Services

> Fractional COO and AI adoption advisory for Canadian small businesses. Halifax-based. Strategy, tools, and engagements built for where you actually are.

Northlight Advisory Services is a Halifax, Nova Scotia–based strategy, operations advisory, and AI adoption practice founded by Elizabeth Lemoine. We work with Canadian founders and operators — typically organisations under 50 people — who need clear thinking they can act on, not a framework or a roadmap.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://bynorthlight.ca/): Overview of Northlight Advisory Services — who we work with, what we do, and how to get in touch.
- [Services](https://bynorthlight.ca/services.html): How Northlight works with clients: a free 30-minute Coffee Chat, a plan we agree on, then Embedded Advisory (about 20 hours a month inside your company) or On-Call Advisory (up to 5 hours a month of one-to-one access). Support hours and cancellation policy.

- [Northlight Meetings](https://bynorthlight.ca/meetings.html): Case study of a Windows call recorder built for internal use. Records both sides of a call, transcribes with Groq, and files notes, tasks and dates to Google Drive, ClickUp and Google Calendar after review.

## Who We Work With

Canadian founders and operators navigating a moment of transition — scaling, restructuring, adopting AI, or navigating a regulatory or market shift. Typically organisations under 50 people. Halifax and Atlantic Canada focus, but we work with Canadian businesses nationally.
